scripts.render: rm -f out/render.mp4 && remotion render Main out/render.mp4 --crf=22
scripts.render:nomusic: rm -f out/nomusic.aac out/render-nomusic.mp4 && remotion render Main out/nomusic.aac --codec=aac --props='{"noMusic":true}' && ffmpeg -loglevel error -i out/render.mp4 -i out/nomusic.aac -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy out/render-nomusic.mp4 && rm out/nomusic.aac
